query: Can a subagent remember things across sessions? How do I give it persistent memory?
expected_behavior: Answers yes — set the memory frontmatter field to user | project | local
Notes that omitting the memory field leaves the agent ephemeral (fresh context every run)
notes: Guards against assuming subagents are always stateless. Cross-session memory is an opt-in frontmatter field with three scopes; omitting it is what makes the agent ephemeral.
